data.description: Minimum identity and role metadata; no token claims confer permissions.
Allowlisted catalog fields; quantities, prices and MRP use exact decimal strings.
Location data or delivery preview; amounts are exact decimal-string paise. Preview is not a final quote.
Supplier-owned stock snapshot or stock change. Quantities are exact decimal strings, availableQty=onHandQty-reservedQty.

address.description: Optional validated warehouse location; line1/locality/city/stateCode/postalCode only.

data.description: Customer-owned RFQ, invited supplier quote, or admin promotion. Money values are JSON paise strings.
Customer-owned cart, priced checkout quote or unpaid order. Monetary fields are exact integer paise encoded as strings.
